times.cancellation_policy:
Armani / Ristorante Reservation Cancellation Policy

We understand that plans can change, and we strive to accommodate all our guests in the best possible way. To ensure we provide excellent service to all our patrons, we ask that you kindly observe the following cancellation policy:

Reservations:
A valid credit card is required to secure all reservations. Walk-ins are welcome based on availability.

Cancellations:
We require at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations to avoid a $25 per person fee (for special events or holidays, 72 hours' notice is required).

No-Shows:
If you miss your reservation without prior notice, you will be charged a $25 per person fee.

Special Events or Holidays:
A $50 deposit per person is required for reservations during these times. The 72-hour cancellation policy applies to avoid forfeiting the deposit.

Late Arrivals:
If you are running late for your reservation, please notify us promptly. Reservations will be held for up to 15 minutes, after which they may be subject to cancellation.

Changing Reservations:
To adjust your reservation (time, date, or guest count), please notify us at least 24 hours in advance (72 hours for special events/holidays). We will do our best to accommodate your request based on availability.

We appreciate your understanding. Your cooperation with our policy helps us ensure a smooth and enjoyable dining experience for all our guests.

We understand that plans can change, and we strive to accommodate all our guests in the best possible way. To ensure we provide excellent service to all our patrons, we ask that you kindly observe the following cancellation policy:

Reservations:
A valid credit card is required to secure all reservations. Walk-ins are welcome based on availability.

Cancellations:
We require at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations to avoid a $25 per person fee (for special events or holidays, 72 hours' notice is required).

No-Shows:
If you miss your reservation without prior notice, you will be charged a $25 per person fee.

Special Events or Holidays:
A $50 deposit per person is required for reservations during these times. The 72-hour cancellation policy applies to avoid forfeiting the deposit.

Late Arrivals:
If you are running late for your reservation, please notify us promptly. Reservations will be held for up to 15 minutes, after which they may be subject to cancellation.

Changing Reservations:
To adjust your reservation (time, date, or guest count), please notify us at least 24 hours in advance (72 hours for special events/holidays). We will do our best to accommodate your request based on availability.

We appreciate your understanding. Your cooperation with our policy helps us ensure a smooth and enjoyable dining experience for all our guests.
